roadmapTask: Horizon 7 — Scheduling (Server slice): implement the Schedule/Server part of ADR-0014 — a schedule: line in Pipeline files (plain words or cron, Project time zone in adops.yaml, validated by adops validate), Schedules compiled to Dagster schedules, run rules (skip overlap, one run at a time per Server, catch up once, retry only Source/Warehouse-unreachable errors 3x5min), Dagster daemon + webserver under a docker-compose "server" profile, and sanitized webhook alerts via a Secret Reference. The Git pull-and-validate loop and Git-based acceptance of Breaking Changes (ADR-0015) are deferred to horizon 8; GitHub Actions workflows are out of scope.
